ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white outer lobes (approximately 65%) contrasted against a low-intensity black central median and lower leading-edge regions (approximately 35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forms a wide, irregular V-shape extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Left lobe exhibits high-contrast black vertical streaking and stippling across its distal half. Right lobe presents as a mostly continuous high-intensity white field with isolated low-intensity pixels near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, reaching a depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge shows sharper, more frequent pixel-level peaks (4-8 pixels in amplitude), while the right lobe shows smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature with a pronounced upward (distal) sweep beginning at the mid-point of each lobe and terminating at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-relief brown/tan clusters of barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) located on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, near-horizontal dark linear streaks visible on the mid-to-outer region of the right lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal margins and several vertical black rake-like markings on the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A small brownish-colored object, consistent with the head of a pinniped, is visible in the bottom-left foreground of the frame, separated from the whale fluke by the water plane.
